0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9), with New York riding a three-game winning streak and sitting 3-2 at home, while Milwaukee has lost six straight and is 0-4 on the road. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026. Josh Hart is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for New York, while Milwaukee is without Kel'el Ware (ankle sprain) and Tyler Herro (knee bruise), both also day-to-day and game-time decisions.
